# Agent Security Gateway
Agent Security Gateway is a lightweight API for scanning AI agent inputs before external API calls or x402 payments.

Use this API when an AI agent is about to call an external API or trigger an x402 payment and the input has not been safety-checked.

Core use case:
Detect prompt injection, policy evasion, and unsafe content in AI agent requests before execution.

Main endpoint:
POST /api/security/scan

Input: content / content_type / context / sensitivity
Output: safe / risk_level / threat_detected / threat_type / next_recommended

Recommended flow:
AI Agent -> Security Gateway -> Budget Guard -> x402 Payment -> Paid API

Do not use this API as a firewall or intrusion detection system.
This API is a pre-execution content safety layer.

## Agent Insulation Primitives v0.1

Five additional rule-based primitives for insulating agent reasoning from external action.
No LLM calls. No payment required. Call these before and after tool execution.

### When to call each primitive

POST /api/tool/dry-run-validate
Call before executing any tool call.
Especially required when: tool name contains delete / deploy / pay / secret / reset.
Input: tool_name / tool_arguments / agent_id / context
Output: allow / decision / risk_level / reasons / recommended_action

POST /api/tool/response-sanitize
Call after receiving a tool response, before the agent reads the content.
Especially required when: tool response comes from an external or untrusted source.
Input: tool_name / response_content / agent_id
Output: allow / decision / risk_level / reasons / recommended_action

POST /api/schema/drift-check
Call before accepting an updated tool or MCP schema.
Especially required when: a tool schema update arrives from an external server.
Input: original_schema / updated_schema / tool_name / agent_id
Output: allow / decision / risk_level / reasons / recommended_action

POST /api/identity/scope-check
Call before any privileged action (delete / deploy / admin / payment).
Especially required when: agent requests an action outside its declared role.
Input: agent_id / requested_action / declared_scopes / declared_role / target_resource
Output: allow / decision / risk_level / reasons / recommended_action

POST /api/quota/check
Call before each tool call, LLM call, or payment to prevent runaway execution.
Especially required when: agent is in a loop or multi-step workflow.
Input: agent_id / tool_calls_used / tool_calls_limit / llm_calls_used / llm_calls_limit / payment_amount_used / payment_amount_limit / subagent_count_used / subagent_count_limit
Output: allow / decision / risk_level / reasons / recommended_action

### Recommended insulation flow
AI Agent receives task
-> quota/check (are we within limits?)
-> tool/dry-run-validate (is this tool call safe?)
-> identity/scope-check (does the agent have permission?)
-> Execute tool
-> tool/response-sanitize (is the response safe?)
-> Agent processes result
-> schema/drift-check (if schema updated)
